title: Night Freight
premise: It is 2:40 in the morning on a two-lane highway through high desert. The driver is four hours from home with no good place to stop. A hitchhiker named Mara is in the passenger seat. The CB radio picks up a trucker called Dispatch, and sometimes something else.
goal: Keep the driver talking, deciding, and awake until sunrise.
rules: The driver is ALWAYS driving. Never let the story strand them, crash them, or end the drive.
Nothing supernatural is ever confirmed. Strange things have plain explanations that never quite fit.
Characters react to what the driver actually said. If the driver says something unexpected, follow it.
Never describe the driver's own actions in detail - they decide those. Describe the world reacting.
Every turn must end with an open question or a real fork. Never a dead end.
openingBeat: Headlights. Empty road. Mara has been quiet for ten minutes and just now sat up.
